meta_description: Muskashears Garden Service in Birmingham offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local family business. Call 07756 479238 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — 15 Years of Experience
hero_subhead: From overgrown lawns to complete garden redesigns, we transform outdoor spaces across Birmingham with expertise and care.
services_subhead: We handle everything from lawn care and hedge trimming to full garden design and landscape projects.

services.title: Lawn Care & Grass Treatment
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, moss treatment, and seasonal feeding to keep your grass healthy and green all year. We carry specialist equipment to handle lawns of any size.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Professional hedge cutting and shrub pruning to maintain shape and encourage growth. We clear cuttings away and leave your garden tidy.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Fortnightly or monthly visits tailored to your garden's needs. Includes weeding, deadheading, and seasonal plant care so you never worry about upkeep.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Transform your outdoor space with bespoke garden design, patio laying, planting schemes, and water features. We listen to your vision and bring it to life.

services.title: Seasonal Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Spring clears, autumn leaf removal, and winter preparation. We haul away all debris and leave your garden ready for the new season.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Felling
services.desc: Safe, professional tree work including pruning, crown reduction, and removal. We handle all waste responsibly and work within council guidelines.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it belongs to one of our own.
about_para_1: Muskashears Garden Service was established in 2009 by local gardener Mark Keeling, who began with a van and passion for transforming neglected gardens. Over 15 years, we've grown to serve households and small businesses across Birmingham and surrounding areas, completing over 2,000 garden projects. Today, we're known for our reliability, eye for detail, and honest pricing.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen first, then act. Whether you need a one-off tidy or a complete redesign, we give you a clear, upfront quote and deliver without hidden charges. Many of our clients have been with us for a decade or more—that's the trust we've built in the Birmingham community.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Garden Owners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our garden. It was completely overgrown and we'd given up on it. Mark and his team came in, had it looking amazing in a day, and they were lovely to work with. Fair pricing too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Muskashears for 5 years now. Every month they turn up on time, do exactly what needs doing, and the garden always looks perfect. No fuss, no drama, just reliable service. Can't ask for better.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Had them design and landscape our back garden. Listened to what we wanted, came up with a brilliant plan, and the whole job was finished ahead of schedule. Quality work, professional team. Really pleased.
reviews.author: James T.
